brief:
Displaced families across Gaza face critical sanitation failures, with access to functioning toilets described as a rare luxury in overcrowded camps, Mondoweiss reported. The absence of adequate toilet facilities has created severe hygiene challenges as families attempt to maintain basic standards of cleanliness amid mass displacement.

The sanitation crisis reflects broader infrastructure collapse in areas housing hundreds of thousands of Palestinians displaced from their homes. Without proper facilities, residents confront heightened risks of disease outbreaks and further deterioration of living conditions already marked by overcrowding and scarcity of essential services.
dek: Without access to toilet facilities, Gaza's displaced families are struggling to recover the most basic standards of hygiene.
title: Gaza displacement camps lack toilet facilities for most residents
